subject: TheraCore - request for accelerated onboarding discount (hosted API)
messages:
From: Andrew Briggs <andrew.briggs@theracore.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Feb 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing - need faster onboarding and budget alignment

Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and multiregion controls look promising. We ran a quick budget pass with procurement and finance. Two constraints: we need an accelerated onboarding (production in 6 weeks) and a 12-month committed usage profile for our care-agent product.

Numbers: estimated steady-state hosted API usage ~120M tokens / month, ramping from 30M month 1. Our CFO has a hard ceiling on the TCO and is asking if you can move on list price by at least 30% to make the math work. If Redwood can offer a 12-month committed rate with 30% off hosted API list, we can sign an LOI this week and commit to a pilot PO next week.

Attached is a draft SOW (SOW v3) and a sketch of our expected token curve. Happy to jump on a short call.

—Andrew
Andrew Briggs
Director, Platform Engineering
TheraCore

Attachments: TheraCore_ML_consumption_SOW_v3.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Andrew Briggs <andrew.briggs@theracore.ai>
Cc: procurement@theracore.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Feb 2029 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - need faster onboarding and budget alignment

Andrew — appreciate the clarity and the SOW. We can move quickly on onboarding and have a dedicated onboarding runbook for customers at your scale. I need to confirm internal approvals for the rate you mentioned.

Quick signal: if TheraCore is able to commit to a 12-month purchase with the token curve in the SOW, we can consider a concession in the low-20s to mid-20s percent range versus hosted API list. I can't confirm 30% from my side without exec signoff.

I am looping in my deal partners to request expedited review today — I'll get back to you with a firm number and a DocuSign-ready SOW by Friday.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2029 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Request: expedited exec approval for hosted-api concession (TheraCore DL-0047)

Team — forwarding Theracore request (attached). Summary and ask below.

Deal snapshot:
- Account: TheraCore (healthcare platform)
- Expected committed volume: 120M tokens / month (steady state) over 12 months
- Ramp: 30M -> 60M -> 90M -> 120M over first 4 months
- Annualized revenue (list): estimated $X.XXM (see attached pricing model)
- Contract ask: 12-month committed hosted API with accelerated onboarding (6-week target)
- Thermo ask: 30% off list to make procurement comfortable; they're ready to sign LOI within days if pricing aligns.

Economics and rationale for concession:
- Unit economics at 22% discount vs list still preserves acceptable margin given expected multi-month ramp and strategic reference value in the payer network.
- Commitment and accelerated onboarding materially reduce CAC and support cross-sell into their provider customers.
- Competitive pressure: competitor Y is offering a blended volume discount; we need a defensible concession to close quickly.

Requested approval: exec authorization to offer TheraCore a 22% hosted API list discount (effective for 12-month committed term) plus a 6-week onboarding SLA. Conditional on legal review of data residency clauses and finance signoff on payment terms.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-model.xlsx, TheraCore_ML_consumption_SOW_v3.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-0047

Why 22% not 30%: 22% preserves runway for potential add-ons (dedicated pools, private deployments) and keeps us within standard delegated concession range for Strategic Mid-Market deals. 30% would require senior leadership signoff and likely margin support.

Requested SLA: can we get a fast-track review? TheraCore indicated LOI this week. I need an answer today to keep momentum.

Thanks — Karthik
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2029 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: expedited exec approval for hosted-api concession (TheraCore DL-0047)

Karthik — reviewed the attachments and the pricing model. High level: TheraCore looks like a strategic mid-market account with potential to expand into Dedicated/Private in Year 2.

I am comfortable authorizing a 22% hosted API list discount for a 12-month committed plan, subject to the following conditions:
1) Finance (Laura) to confirm acceptable payment cadence and credit exposure limits.
2) Legal to sign off on the proposed data residency and audit clauses in the SOW.
3) Final offer to include a rollback clause: if committed spend falls below 75% of forecast for two consecutive quarters, revert to standard pricing for the remainder of the term.

If finance/legal are OK, consider this an exec-level authorization — please do not exceed 22% without escalating back to me.

Mina
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
